newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish mostly lower, near lows.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish mostly lower, near lows.

text.p: March 4 - IMM currency futures ended mostly lower, near lows. Offers re-emerged at close, with sentiment tilted to downside in currencies. Others looked for dollar to struggle to overcome 1.7150 or about $0.5835 in March marks, which set new contract low at $0.5834. Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony Wednesday, German jobless figures due Thursday. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
